cmd:
systemctl cat chan-orders-regr | grep -E "Environment|ExecStart|WorkingDirectory|User" | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'; echo ---; cd /opt/trading-bot/positions && cat > /tmp/timing.py <<'EOF2'
import time, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/trading-bot/positions')
import chan_orders as C
now=int(time.time()*1000)
pairs=C.pairs_now(); print('pairs',len(pairs))
tot=0; rows=[]
for sym in pairs:
    t0=time.time(); A=C.analyze(sym,now); t1=time.time()
    rows.append((round(t1-t0,2),sym))
rows.sort(reverse=True); print('analyze total %.1fs, slowest'%sum(r[0] for r in rows), rows[:6])
# propose+eval_events and _tg_info timing on a few pairs
evs=C.load_events(); tp=0; ti=0; tsh=0
for sym in pairs:
    A=C.analyze(sym,now)
    if not A: continue
    t0=time.time(); ps=C.propose(sym,A,evs)+C.eval_events(sym,A,evs); t1=time.time(); tp+=t1-t0
    try: C.tg_gate.watch_needed(sym)
    except Exception: pass
    t2=time.time(); C._tg_info(sym,A); ti+=time.time()-t2
print('propose+eval total %.1fs  _tg_info total %.1fs'%(tp,ti))
t0=time.time(); import trend_shadow; trend_shadow.shadow(pairs[3],'long'); print('shadow one call %.2fs'%(time.time()-t0))
EOF2
POS_DIR=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr CHAN_SRC=regr CHAN_EDGE=1 TG_GATE=1 PYTHONPATH=/opt/trading-bot/positions timeout 200 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/timing.py 2>&1 | tail -8 | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
